thread:
maria-support: FYI — multiple customers reporting 502/504s to Hosted API in eu-west-1 starting ~09:12 UTC. Tickets C-1245 / C-1246. Sample req id: c7f8a9d1 | trace=tr-9fb2. Repro attached.

maria-support: CURL sample to reproduce (redacted token):
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \n  -H \"X-Billing-Account: 8765\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"input":"hello world"}' \n  \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\"
```

kevin-eng-sre: Investigating now. Do we know if this is auth proxy upstream or frontdoor LB dropping streams?

maria-support: Initial logs show a mix — upstream reset from auth tier + frontdoor connwindow saturation. Noticed a header-trim config rolled earlier this morning (~08:50).

sara-observability: Dashboard snapshot: eu-west-1 edge_502_rate jumped from ~1% to 18% at 09:11. h2_active_streams spiked x3, keepalive_conn_in_use peaked. No large deploys recorded after 07:30.

deploy-bot: last_deploy: 2025-11-25T07:30:12Z (frontend-lb-config). No recent app rollouts.

alex-eng-runtime: grabbing envoy logs from frontdoor. Quick tail: 
```
[envoy][warning] 2026-02-14T09:12:33Z upstream reset: stream aborted, connection_reset, req_id=c7f8a9d1
[proxy][error] 2026-02-14T09:12:34Z auth-cache redis timeout (100ms) for key tenant:8765
[frontdoor][info] conn_window_exhausted: streams=1024, max_streams=1024
```

kevin-eng-sre: That conn_window_exhausted + redis timeouts feels like auth-cache is causing backpressure -> frontdoor exhausting h2 streams and returning 502/504. Can someone share tenant traffic pattern? Any big embed/batch jobs?

tim-support: Affected customer AcmeCorp reported a batch embedding job ~09:05 with 1200 items in one request. They marked P1. Workaround suggested: retry with batch_size=128 which reduced errors in their repro.

alex-eng-runtime: Confirmed high long-lived streaming and very large request bodies around that time. These long streams are tying up h2 concurrency. We have many open streams per connection (keepalives).

kevin-eng-sre: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Increase frontdoor keepalive conn pool and temporary bump max concurrent streams, 2) Enable fallback route to midproxy for new requests from affected tenants, 3) Add a short-term auth-cache TTL relaxation to reduce redis calls. I'll coordinate with ops.

ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled service frontdoor-eu1 by +30% (3 -> 4 nodes) at 09:40 UTC.

sara-observability: Metrics post-mitigation: edge_502_rate down from 18% -> 4% within 6m after scaling + pool bump. h2_active_streams returning to baseline.

maria-support: Noted. Communicated workaround to AcmeCorp (reduce batch size) and informed they can retry now. Creating P1 postmortem and will add repro steps.

kevin-eng-sre: Follow-ups: RCA to include header-trim config impact, h2 default max_streams calc, and auth-cache redis latency thresholds. Also suggest per-tenant rate-limit on batch sizes for hosted.

tim-support: I'll update the customer with the mitigation + ETA for RCA. :thumbsup:

maria-support: Thanks all — keeping thread open for RCA notes. Will file internal incident doc and link once done.
